reason: Registrations establish that a client sought to influence legislation. They do not say what was asked for, of whom, or when.
exact_record: Client issue reports at the bill level, where filed.
status: CLOSED — the record does not exist under Connecticut law
public_record_shows: Connecticut does not require bill-level lobbying reports. Client lobbyists file periodic financial reports of expenditures and contract terms (CGS 1-96); the only issue disclosure is the two-year registration, which lists in general terms the areas the registrant expects to lobby on (CGS 1-95(a)(5)). There is no “client issue report” to request.
still_missing: What was actually asked of whom can only come from testimony already in this record or from communications obtained by records request.
